TimeFeatures add-on

The TimeFeatures add-on streamlines end-to-end feature engineering workflows inside Orange. It lets you

  1. Construct temporal features – create lags, rolling statistics and arbitrary expressions with the Time Features Constructor node.

  2. Visualise variable dependencies – build an interactive directed graph that shows which variables depend on which others and, for shifts, the exact time lag, via the Variable Dependency Graph node.

  3. Persist datasets – write any table (raw data, engineered features, target labels, …) to PostgreSQL with a single click using Save to DB.
